"
Bufo
"
scorteccii
(
Scortecci's toad
) is a species of
toad
in the family
Bufonidae
.
[
2
]
It is
endemic
to
Yemen
, with its range restricted to a plateau near the western region of
Mafhaq
. Its natural
habitats
are shrubland as well as wetland areas.
[
1
]
It was originally described in the genus
Bufo
in 1970.
[
3
]
In 2006, it was removed from that genus but not assigned to another genus until 2009 when it was assigned to
Duttaphrynus
.
[
3
]
This was reversed in 2015 due to physical characteristics that are similar to both
Duttaphrynus
and
Sclerophrys
.
[
3
